pacon.title: One-stop IDE for Adaptive Application development and test
pacon.description:
PACON IDE(Popcorn Automotive CONtainer Integrated Development Environment) is an integrated development environment, providing basic features for Adaptive Application development such as coding, debugging, compiling and distribution.

One of biggest advantages of PACON IDE is docker container, which enables to provide a faster and lighter development environment then usual virtual environment technologies. Users can access the development environment based on docker container through Vscode.

The IDE has already installed extension features for efficiently developing Adaptive applications, so users have no needs to spend extra time installing and updating them and concentrate on developing the applications directly.

Docker container provides an identical environment to the one of actual target ECU for SOP. Users can implement, test and simulate their Adaptive applications in the container which will work exactly same in the target board.

Another point is that PACON IDE is based on Vscode which is familiar with SW developers. Users can edit source code in real-time, connect to version control programs and external storage systems for building and testing, and take advantage of different languages including C++.

parvisai.title:
PARVIS (PopcornSAR Adaptive & Classic Runtime Vehicle Intelligence System)
AI-based Automotive Software Development Deliverable Automation
parvisai.description:
ASPICE is an assessment model for systematically managing quality and safety in the automotive software development process, and has recently been used by vehicle manufacturers and major partners as a key standard for ensuring project quality. However, its extensive documentation and verification steps lead to long development cycles and high manpower dependence.
PopcornSAR has developed an AI-based automotive software development deliverable automation product to improve this inefficiency. By connecting the entire process of design, development, and verification into a single data flow, it minimizes repetitive work and automatically generates documents, code, and test deliverables that comply with the ASPICE process, thereby improving both quality and productivity.
parvisai.subtitle: Automatic ASPICE Deliverable Generation Across the Entire AI-Assisted Vehicle Software Development Process
parvisai.overview: This product links the three phases of design (PARVIS-Spec), development (PARVIS-Coder), and verification (PARVIS-Verify) into one, allowing AI to handle repetitive and formalized tasks while human decision-making is preserved. It creates a unified data flow from requirement specification analysis to code safety assurance and test coverage analysis, thereby enhancing the quality and productivity of ASPICE deliverables simultaneously.
parvisai.specDescription: PARVIS-Spec automatically analyzes specification documents to structure requirements and auto-generate a requirements-code-test traceability matrix. The AI-based natural language processing engine analyzes the document's meaning to automatically extract technical requirements, minimizing repetitive document analysis tasks. Through this, even if requirements change, the code and test items are immediately synchronized, maintaining consistency across the entire project.
parvisai.coderDescription: PARVIS-Coder ensures the quality and consistency of development deliverables through Code Safety automation and automatic API documentation generation. An AI refactoring algorithm automatically applies MISRA-C and internal coding rules, and simultaneously generates comment-based API documentation. Developers can focus on ensuring code quality while being freed from repetitive formatting tasks.
parvisai.verifyDescription: PARVIS-Verify performs test coverage analysis and automatic test code generation, systematically accelerating the verification phase. It automatically generates test scenarios based on test requirements and continuously updates coverage by reflecting code change history. This enhances verification quality while significantly reducing testing time.
parvisai.performance:
Performance Indicators (PERFORMANCE)
- MISRA-C Compliance Rate: 40% -> 94% (+54%)
- Documentation Coverage: 5% -> 100% (+95%)
- Test Coverage: 0% -> 86.4% (+86%)
- Increased work efficiency: 3 to 4 times higher than conventional processes

These results are actual figures obtained by PopcornSAR's AI Agent experts through automating the entire design-development-verification process, demonstrating consistent quality and efficiency even in large-scale projects.
parvisai.integration: Through integration with AutoSAR.io and PARA, design-code-verification automation optimized for the Adaptive AUTOSAR environment is provided. The PARVIS command-line tool enables automatic generation of components for each module, and it easily integrates with existing DevOps and CI/CD environments. This makes it possible to transition from the traditional manual-centric development approach to a fully AI-driven development pipeline.
parvisai.benefits:
- Error Reduction - AI-based automation minimizes human errors and improves code quality.
- Call Optimization - Optimized API call structure enhances processing speed.
- Token Savings - Efficient data processing reduces operational costs.
- Better Usability - Intuitive interface and workflow maximize development productivity.
parvisai.afterHoursMode:
After Hours Mode is an intelligent session tracking system that automatically proceeds with tasks and records all session execution details even when developers are absent.
Through the /mode command, you can switch between auto-approval mode (bypass) and unattended work mode (after-hours), and track all tool usage and token consumption in real-time.
It automatically generates session-by-session statistics, task timelines, and project-wide summaries, enabling transparent management of development progress. This establishes a 24-hour continuous development environment and maximizes work efficiency and traceability.

parvisai.afterHoursFeature2: No Bypass Mode: Regular work mode that manually confirms all permission requests

cloudNative.title: Cloud Native-based AA Development Solution
cloudNative.text1:
"Cloud Native" is an approach that considers scalability and flexibility in developing, deploying, and managing applications in a cloud computing environment. It supports tools and technologies that enable efficient application development using cloud infrastructure.

In particular, Cloud Native technologies allow the rapid deployment of various applications without affecting user service usage.
cloudNative.text2:
PopcornSAR has built its development tools and platform using Cloud Native, ensuring that developers have the same experience no matter the environment they access.

This is referred to as Cloud Native Automotive Software, and PopcornSAR covers all aspects of DevOps that align with Cloud Native Automotive Software to support efficient AA development.
cloudNative.text3: As a result, from a user perspective, there are advantages in terms of cost savings over the long term, as there is no need to build physical infrastructure, and the ability to use resources flexibly during the required periods. Additionally, by configuring ARM 64-based Virtual ECUs, AA testing can be performed in an environment identical to the actual Target ECU, significantly reducing development barriers and meeting the requirements of the SDV paradigm shift in building the App ecosystem.
cloudNative.text4:
PopcornSAR's Cloud Native utilizes AWS (Amazon Web Services) resources, enabling the provision of stable services.

It can also flexibly respond to customer demands by expanding resources in case of service interruptions due to feature updates or sudden increases in usage,

thereby providing a positive customer experience.

digitalTwin.title: Digital Twin-Integrated AA Development Solution
digitalTwin.text1:
As the era of SDV (Software-defined Vehicle) approaches, various functionalities that will be applied to future vehicles require a simulation environment such as a Digital Twin,

based on data related to vehicle system performance and operating conditions, to perform tests under conditions identical to those of actual vehicles.
digitalTwin.text2:
The reason for this is that, to realize SDVs, it is crucial to monitor and perform pre-implementation checks to ensure that functionality safety,

the most critical aspect, is not adversely affected before actual production of vehicles.
digitalTwin.text3:
Digital Twin also plays a significant role from the perspective of Adaptive AUTOSAR development. One of the biggest advantages is that, due to the visual nature of Digital Twins,

it becomes easier to verify the functionality of AAs (Adaptive Applications) developed based on Adaptive AUTOSAR. This, in turn, facilitates development, debugging,

error correction, and more. Through early issue detection, SW development, maintenance, and improvement tasks can be performed efficiently.
digitalTwin.text4:
PopcornSAR's key product, AA (Adaptive Application) developed based on Adaptive AUTOSAR, is integrated with the Digital Twin developed by our partner company MORAI, enabling the implementation of various autonomous driving technologies,

from basic control to advanced capabilities in vehicles.

ai.title: AI Model-Integrated AA Development Solution
ai.text1:
PopcornSAR provides support for migrating AI models to Adaptive Applications (AAs)

while considering integration with AI-specific open-source frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch.
ai.text2:
When migrating complex AI models implemented with TensorFlow to AAs, issues can arise.

Some problems include lower compiler versions in AI SDKs that incorporate PyTorch modules provided by semiconductor companies,

lack of support for certain functionalities required for Adaptive AUTOSAR, and mismatches with the essential C++ version for Adaptive AUTOSAR,

resulting in compilation and operational issues for AAs.
ai.text3:
To address these challenges, PopcornSAR modifies its Adaptive AUTOSAR Stack to align with the compiler version used by AI. We provide a proprietary SOME/IP module implemented in Python to enable integration between AI implemented in Python and control-oriented AAs. Additionally,

PopcornSAR offers support to develop Python-based AI into C++ based Adaptive AUTOSAR AI once AI model validation is complete,

integrating the Adaptive AUTOSAR Stack into existing AI SDKs.
ai.text4: Furthermore, we also provide an ARM-based Docker container virtual ECU that operates on the ARM development board and development PC without modifying the logic of AI models implemented in Python.
ai.text5: * Examples of PopcornSAR's solutions and AI integration: NXP's S32G2 and eIQ-AUTO (AI SDK)

autosar.content1:
In the software industry, when development scales increase, it is common to use a software platform to improve reusability and development efficiency. By eliminating hardware dependencies and reusing only applications and their libraries that run on the software platform, AUTOSAR similarly reduces development time and costs through this process.

ECUs installed in automobiles are used under special conditions such as temperature, humidity, and vibration, so MCUs (Micro Controller Units) have lower performance in memory and processing power compared to general computers, as durability and reliability must be improved. Therefore, there was often no room to install a software platform. However, recently, ECUs have become more advanced and complex to improve vehicle safety and convenience, and MCU performance has also improved significantly.

Due to these changes, the introduction of software platforms for ECUs was greatly demanded, and AUTOSAR emerged mainly in Europe, creating standard platform specifications for automotive software.

AUTOSAR (AUTomotive Open System ARchitecture) is a global development partnership and standard name in the automotive industry founded in 2003, with the main purpose of establishing and establishing a common standard software architecture for Electronic Control Units (ECUs). Since its founding, through collaboration among member companies, it aims to improve reliability throughout the vehicle product lifecycle, including scalability to respond to various vehicle types and platforms, software portability, and availability safety requirement responses.

Also, based on the slogan of cooperating on standardization and competing on implementation, AUTOSAR only publishes specifications and leaves implementation to the discretion of AUTOSAR member companies. As of 2019, the AUTOSAR association has 270 companies including 9 Core partners, and PopcornSAR is a Development Partner that contributes greatly to standardization work.
autosar.content2:
Platforms such as Classic Platform and pre-AUTOSAR platforms such as OSEC/VDX, which are based on a static Operating System were mainly used control type ECUs such as brakes, transmissions and engines that require an exact real-time function execution.
However, a trend shift from the hardware to the software caused introduction of new technologies such as ADAS(Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) and IVI(In-Vehicle Infotainment) led active OS platforms such as POSIX, QNX being used.
The connect-everything deviceization of an automobile has already begun. In this trend shift, AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform can implement a rapid calculation and communications, configure highly responsive software and enables interaction of vehicle and traffic signals through real-time external data process with ethernet. In this process, accurate interpretation and judgement are performed. Other services such as security, remote diagnosis and wireless update can be supported.
In case of application developers, by using ARA(AUTOSAR Runtime for Adaptive Applications, Provides a standardized interface for integrating applications into systems) as a structure of internal ECU and network communication can access to basic services such as diagnosis, network management and decryption.
PopcornSAR provides PopcornSAR's own design tool and ara:: for function implementation.
For details, click at the PRODUCTS section of this website.
